answer_in_app_store_connect: No, we do not collect data from this app
notes: User-selected files and device diagnostics move only between the user's Apple device, local reader, and user-selected storage. Crash reports are saved locally and exported only by an explicit user action. UserDefaults stores the last reader address inside this app, and file metadata is read only for files or folders explicitly selected by the user. Optional KOReader sync, off by default, sends a book-file fingerprint, reading position, device name and a random installation ID with the user's username and password-derived key to a KOReader sync server the user chooses; the developer does not operate or receive data from that server, so it is treated like a user-configured service rather than developer collection. Confirm this interpretation when answering the App Privacy questionnaire. The library, reading positions and settings stay on the device. iCloud key-value storage (on by default when signed in to iCloud) keeps the same position records in the user's own iCloud account; the developer cannot access it, so it is not developer collection.
